doc: Relative humidity of the source air by latitude, float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree, Hadley edge 10 (10 and 90 are the clamp bounds of hadley_edge_deg): t clipped at 0 and 1, smoothstep fall from 1 to 0.2. A float64 closed form: rtol 1e-9. Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 4.4e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is more than 1e5 times that spread.
